{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,

response: {"thought": "語意層沒有對應「物流商」與「配送天數」，我先直接檢查 shipments 表的日期格式、空值與 carrier 內容，確認要用哪個時間欄位篩選第二季。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(delivered_ts) AS delivered_not_null, COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS carriers, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped FROM shipments", "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC"]}}
